title: Success Chime
blurb: An ascending major arpeggio, which is the most reliably optimistic shape in Western music and the reason every app reaches for it. Task complete, payment accepted, answer correct: this is the sound of a small victory being formally recognised. It works because the pitch rises and then resolves — your brain reads it as a finished journey rather than an interrupted one. Use it for channel-point wins, quiz-night answers, or ironically after doing the absolute bare minimum. The optimistic sibling of the wrong-answer buzzer, and the two make an excellent double act.
origin: Original C-major arpeggio synthesis in the style of app success sounds.
